text:
Alex Chen: Noticed a bug in the API ref for POST /v1/generate: the curl example shows `?include_metadata=\"true\"` (quoted) which the server treats as a string and can produce 400s for some SDK flows.

Marta Lopez: Yikes. Paste the snippet?

Alex Chen: Current curl:
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?include_metadata=\"true\"' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Server expects boolean or omission. Fix options: unquote query `?include_metadata=true` or move boolean into JSON body.

Rick Patel: I'll open a docs PR to update curl + Node fetch snippet and add a migration note. Will scan Ruby/Go examples too.

Maya Singh: Also add a one-line callout under the param: "Prefer body boolean; if using query flags, do not quote boolean values." Helps integrators quickly find it.

Rick Patel: Drafted PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 — updates curl, Node snippet (include_metadata in body boolean), adds migration note. Kept SDK examples but added a comment. Ran curl against staging, returned 200.

Marta Lopez: Tiny copy nit: change "legacy clients" to "older clients" and show the quoted example in monospace. Add a short header note in the endpoint overview: "Boolean query flags must be unquoted."

Rick Patel: Updated per nit. Adjusted docs CI to run the curl with `--silent --fail` so it fails on non-2xx. Ran smoke tests on staging, all good.

docs-bot: PR merged by marta-lopez: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ef45ac12 — "docs(generate): fix include_metadata examples and add note"

deploy-bot: staging deploy started: docs-site/docs@staging build #8533

Maya Singh: API side LGTM. We should not accept quoted booleans server-side; that hides contract issues. Recommend telemetry to track quoted booleans for a migration window.

Alex Chen: Filed ENG-1123 to add telemetry for quoted boolean query params. Will monitor integrator errors and consider a deprecation message if common.

Rick Patel: Merged to main after copy check. Closing thread. Thanks! :tada:
